system: Answer the question briefly. Give the final numeric result, without working or a list of alternatives.

cases.question: There are 29 components. We use 11 and then receive 4. How many are there now?
A kit contains 41 screws. Four assemblies each use 6 screws. How many screws remain?
A cable is 2.7 metres long. We cut off 45 centimetres. How many centimetres remain?
A timer starts at minute 9 and runs for 22 minutes within the same hour. At which minute does it stop?
A triangle has sides of 8, 11 and 13 metres. What is its perimeter in metres?
A pump supplies 2.5 litres per minute for 6 minutes. How many litres does it supply?
Seven tickets cost 4 pounds each and there is one additional booking fee of 3 pounds. What is the total in pounds?
A register starts at 8. Add 5, double the new value, then subtract 6. What is the final value?
Container A has 17 litres and container B has 11 litres. Transfer 4 litres from A to B without loss. What is their combined volume in litres?
Mina has 18 tokens. Sol has 5 fewer. Ren has three times as many as Sol. How many tokens does Ren have?
A delivery was scheduled for day 16. It is delayed by 5 days, then brought forward by 2 days. On which day will it arrive?
A resistor has 15 volts across it and carries 3 amperes. Using V = I times R, what is its resistance in ohms?
An object moves 90 metres in 6 seconds at constant speed. What is its speed in metres per second?
A stack receives 7, then 12, then 19. Two last-in-first-out pops occur. Which number remains?
What is the bitwise AND of the nonnegative integers 13 and 6, expressed in decimal?
